title: Brugada Calls for National Unity as Sheinbaum Holds 'Honesty and Results' Event at the Zócalo
detail: Head of Government Clara Brugada welcomed President Claudia Sheinbaum to the 'Honestidad y Resultados en la Ciudad de México' event at the Zócalo on September 27, and called for national unity against 'imperialist ambition' following remarks by Donald Trump at the UN. On September 28 she reiterated the call for unity around the President in three areas.
